purpose: Outcome-blind cross-module admission/falsification matrix; PF052 local and PF053 unmerged are cited as secondary not canonical main.

gates.hypothesis: Reported ETF unit changes plus complete date-effective PCF identify conditional delivery exposure.
gates.support: Official units and PCF have source clocks.
gates.counter: Unit delta may include reversals/actions; AP inventory, collective creation and cash substitution break same-day execution inference.
gates.alternative: Administrative unit actions or inventory finance.
gates.failure: Missing immutable full PCF, unit-action lineage, per-constituent substitution or independently verified firstKnownAt.

gates.hypothesis: Index rebalance exposure adds information beyond primary ETF unit changes.
gates.support: A zero-unit-change fund may still change constituents.
gates.counter: Fund holdings and index events share one parent; end-state holdings are not executions.
gates.alternative: Tracking, sampling, cash reallocation and multi-day transition.
gates.failure: Event announcement/effective/source clocks or pre-event weight vintages missing.
gates.decision: One event root; D11-14 event and D06-11 flow and D06-16 mechanism not independent votes.

gates.support: Multiple PIT actor, leverage, liquidity and ownership axes may co-occur.
gates.counter: Price/volume and ETF/index parent receipts are duplicated across consumers; simultaneous movement can be market-wide.
gates.alternative: Regime, sector, momentum and shared inventory funding.
gates.failure: Same-generation compatible PRICE_OHLC/VOLUME_TURNOVER parent identity or common support absent.
gates.decision: No scalar score, no independent crowding vote until exact shared lineage and residual OOS.

gates.hypothesis: Financing and borrowed-short observations confirm ETF-driven price pressure.
gates.support: Borrowing may finance basket delivery and hedging.
gates.counter: Margin financing, margin short and SBL short have distinct populations; later version may revise next-day eligibility without revising today's short flow.
gates.alternative: Hedge, dealer inventory, settlement or liquidity provision.
gates.failure: Same-date EARLY/LATE source versions or native-unit/denominator reconciliation missing.
gates.decision: Preserve separate universes, next-day eligibility clock and non-directional semantics.

gates.hypothesis: Observed borrow fee and displayed supply quantify crowded short exposure.
gates.support: In-slot TWSE competitive fee is observable for fixed securities.
gates.counter: Displayed lend/borrow zero does not prove zero lendable inventory; negotiated and competitive families differ.
gates.alternative: Quote sparsity, negotiated lending or term/recall differences.
gates.failure: Missing 15:20±5m receipt, source date, rate family or true total-lendable denominator.

gates.hypothesis: Weekly concentration changes predict stock returns.
gates.support: Certified clean 1852-symbol pair and frozen signed 400+ change protocol exist.
gates.counter: Single TDCC pair is one time observation; cohort changes with actions and listing.
gates.alternative: Price response, passive ownership, float change or denominator shift.
gates.failure: New sourceDate not >2026-10-08, pair-specific clean cohort absent, or fewer than 12 genuine postfreeze pairs and two regimes.
gates.decision: No L4; no timeless reuse of prior 1852-symbol cohort.

gates.hypothesis: Conditional ETF basket proxy predicts five-session forward residual return.
gates.support: A fixed predecision feature could be tested versus market/industry/size/liquidity/volatility/momentum/turnover baseline.
gates.counter: Incomplete PCF, future volume, non-tradable opens, overlapping labels and missing fund-date coverage can generate spurious significance.
gates.alternative: Index news, contemporaneous institutional flows, stale versions or selection bias.
gates.failure: No D16/00 prereg acceptance, chronological purge, source firstKnownAt or true executable outcome.
gates.decision: OUTCOMES_CLOSED; two-sided sign-unspecified single-primary-feature test only after approval.

gates.hypothesis: Fund-label permutation is a valid falsification.
gates.support: Conditionally exchangeable labels may reveal accidental fund-identity memorization.
gates.counter: Unconditional shuffling changes constituent membership, fund style and sector exposures.
gates.alternative: Negative control within matched date, sector, size, liquidity and basket support.
gates.decision: Unconditional placebo REJECTED; conditional placebo only after D16 review.
